_doc: GAS-STATION-LIFT-01: the Caliche gas station shop's own picture (S47StationLook): a 1980s photograph under fluorescent tubes, as a bounded post-process volume on the shop's interior only (the station model's room, from its pivot in gas_cosmos.json). saturation, contrast: Unreal's global colour grading; gamma, gain: RGB; offset_shadows: lifted blacks; gain_highlights: soft highlights; grain, vignette, bloom: Unreal's intensities (grain_size only for the look material). blend_cm: the volume's blend outside the box; window_inset_cm: the box pulled in from the window and door wall (town x -17.2) so the blend stays off the pavement; priority: above the global volume (0). material: an optional post-process material after the tone pass with these as parameters, loaded if present. Every key optional: the code's defaults are these values. Read once when the station is built. Not read by S47Props.

exterior._doc: The forecourt's own, much milder grade: a sphere round the canopy (centre: town metres from the station's pivot; radius_m) with a wide blend (blend_m) so no edge is ever seen; priority one under the shop's box, above the global volume. bloom is not overridden here. Off unless enabled.
